title: 研究过程词汇
goal: 区分研究词汇的意义并按研究环节选择用词。

points.label: 区分研究过程词汇的含义
按研究环节选择适当词语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 研究过程包括提出问题、选择方法、记录数据和解释结果。各环节的词语表示不同的对象或动作。
evidence 是支持某个判断的证据，proof 是足以确立这个判断的证明。evidence may support a claim; proof establishes it.
sample 是研究对象中的样本；population 是研究所关注的总体。例如 a sample of students 来自 the student population。

cards.title: 词汇表：问题与假设
rows: The objective is to compare results.

cards.title: 词汇表：观察与数据
rows: A pattern emerged in the data.

items.stem: Which term refers to the whole group a study concerns?
items.why: population 指研究关注的总体；sample 是其中的样本。

items.stem: Which term refers to material that supports a claim?
items.why: evidence 指支持判断的证据。

groups.text: A team wanted to learn whether shade affected seedling growth. It placed similar seedlings in two areas, one shaded and one sunny. Each week the team measured their height and recorded the readings. The team then compared the measurements from the two areas.

items.stem: What did the team record each week?
options: The amount of shade in each area
The comparison of the two areas
The growth of the shaded seedlings only
The heights measured in both areas
items.why: Each week the team measured their height and recorded the readings 说明每周记录的是两处幼苗的高度，即第四项。第二项的比较是最后一步，不是每周记录的内容。

options: Light levels in the two areas
Heights from the first and last weeks
items.why: compared the measurements from the two areas 说明比较对象是两处的测量值，即第一项。

groups.text: A transport researcher asked residents how they travelled to work. The survey covered a sample from several neighbourhoods. The answers provided evidence about travel choices, but the researcher noted that the sample did not include every resident.

items.why: a sample from several neighbourhoods 指参与调查的部分居民。

items.stem: What provided evidence about travel choices?
options: The researcher's note on the sample
The neighbourhoods chosen for the survey
The answers residents gave about travel
The question about travel to work
items.why: The answers provided evidence about travel choices 说明提供证据的是居民的回答，即第三项。

groups.fill: Scientists studied a pond. They tes{ted} a hypot{hesis} about wa{ter} quality a{nd} collected a sam{ple} from t{he} site. T{he} researchers reco{rded} each obser{vation} and anal{yzed} the data before reaching a conclusion. They visited at the same time on several days and used the same equipment for each reading. Their notes described the conditions during each visit, including recent rain. The team compared the readings and discussed what the results could support. The report also described limits of the sample and suggested further visits.

items.stem: Which term describes a proposed explanation that can be tested?
Which term means a result noted during an investigation?
Which term identifies the part of a population selected for study?
items.why: sample 是从总体中选出的样本。

items.stem: The team wrote down instrument values each morning. What did it record?
items.why: 仪器数值是 readings，record readings 表示记录读数。

items.stem: The team examined two sets of results for similarities and differences. What did it do?
items.why: 寻找两组结果的异同是 compare the results。

items.stem: A report explains that the sample came from one area only. What does this describe?
items.why: 样本只来自一处是研究的 limitation。
